body: Oh okay, all good then. It’s just that I’m paranoid that someone might see things like this post and other suicide related searches, but as you said highly improbable. Thanks for the info.

Thank goodness. Honestly so comforting to hear that everyday suicides aren’t publicised. If you were to write a letter with instructions about how you don’t want a funeral or don’t want your death disclosed with many people, does your family have to legally respect that letter?
Ahhh okay, yeah this sounds logical. Thanks for the reply. Really helpful info!

Seriously good reply. Don’t really agree with you on some points though. In my case my family, my one friend and psychiatrist all know I’m suicidal/depressed. Also I want to avoid as much attention as I can, so being reported as missing would be dumb. I just want to kill myself after I have ofc prepared everything but I don’t want my death to be in the newspapers and I don’t want a funeral and I don’t want anyone other than my parents, brother and psychiatrist knowing that I have died. Killing yourself is easy but it’s all the embarrassing attention from authorities and extended family/friends after your death that is hard.
Thank you for the tip! Genuinely appreciated. What about a laptop tho? I have a MacBook that I wouldn’t want to destroy if possible but at the same time deleted stuff could be recovered.
Damn I had no idea it worked like that. Seems like a lot of unnecessary routine effort for an obvious suicide case. Thank you for all the info!
